input_refs: Magnolia route qualification receipt for job 575311
goal: Prevent a model-build plan from depending on a GPU route the owner cannot actually use.
procedure: Treat owner-reported access as binding, recover the last physically qualified usable route, remove the unsupported A100 execution artifact, bind the smoke to the proven 2xP100 scheduler request, require the expected visible device count/type, and keep Kaggle as quota-conserving fallback rather than first choice.
constraints: do not infer usable access from mere schedulability evidence
do not burn Kaggle quota while an adequate free Magnolia route exists
no private identity data during infrastructure smoke
decision_criteria: route previously completed under the owner's account
runtime can perform required forward/backward work
compute usage is bounded before long training
authority: Infrastructure planning only; no identity-training authority.
validation: The P100 smoke must observe two P100 GPUs and complete corpus/tokenizer/model/backward preflight before the MLM pilot starts.
failure_or_lesson: A theoretically schedulable accelerator is not the same as an actually usable owner route. Reuse verified infrastructure evidence and owner corrections instead of re-deriving access assumptions.
notes: Portable Fable lesson: compute planning must adapt to the consumer/device reality instead of hard-coding an ideal accelerator.
